description: This file defines the 'Meeting' class for the SuiteCRM application, handling meeting-related data and behaviors such as scheduling, notifications, relationships, permissions, and external API integrations.

classes.name: Meeting
classes.description: Represents a meeting entity within SuiteCRM, managing its properties, relationships, permissions, notifications, external API integrations, and lifecycle behaviors.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Meeting object, sets up custom fields, and loads duration options.

methods.name: ACLAccess
methods.description: Controls edit and delete permissions for the meeting, especially regarding recurring meetings sourced externally.

methods.name: hasIntegratedMeeting
methods.description: Stub method indicating whether the meeting has external integrations; defaults to false.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the meeting record, processes date calculations, handles external API scheduling, notifications, and vCal caching.

methods.name: removeUnInvitedFromReminders
methods.description: Filters out invitees who are not part of the current meeting's contacts, users, or leads from reminder data.

methods.name: mark_deleted
methods.description: Deletes the meeting and corrects recurrences; updates vCal cache.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the meeting, typically the name.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Builds a SQL query to export meeting data based on filters and ordering.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Populates additional derived or related fields like assigned user name and contact details.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares data for list views, adding formatted dates, status icons, and related info.

methods.name: set_notification_body
methods.description: Populates a notification template with meeting details for email alerts.

methods.name: create_notification_email
methods.description: Creates an email notification about the meeting, attaching an iCal if configured.

methods.name: send_assignment_notifications
methods.description: Removes temporary ics files after notification emails are sent.

methods.name: get_meeting_users
methods.description: Retrieves users associated with this meeting, including their acceptance status.

methods.name: get_invite_meetings
methods.description: Retrieves meetings that a specific user is invited to but has not accepted.

methods.name: set_accept_status
methods.description: Sets the acceptance status for a user, contact, or lead regarding this meeting.

methods.name: get_notification_recipients
methods.description: Determines which users, contacts, or leads should receive notifications about this meeting.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Indicates that this class implements the ACL interface.

methods.name: listviewACLHelper
methods.description: Provides access control logic for list views, based on ownership and group permissions.

methods.name: save_relationship_changes
methods.description: Saves related records such as contacts or users linked to this meeting.

methods.name: afterImportSave
methods.description: Links contacts or leads after importing a meeting.

methods.name: getDefaultStatus
methods.description: Returns the default status for a new meeting, based on schema defaults.
